{{Otheruses|Water|more=Boss (disambiguation)}}
'''Water Boss''' was a position within the community known as [[The Puddle]]. The Water Boss was in charge of [[Water/Legends|water]] purification and distribution to the settlement. The Water Boss had to have an extensive knowledge of the technical aspects of water production, as well as a canny businessperson to handle to the negotiations that came with the job. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Tanse]] served as the Water Boss under [[Tilossa]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
